Application Data.NAME: Blooming Petals Floristry
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Blooming Petals Floristry specializes in the design and arrangement of fresh and dried floral products for various occasions, including weddings, corporate events, and holidays. Our operations include sourcing organic flowers and plants from local growers, as well as providing customized arrangements and gifts. We ensure compliance with all state and federal regulations regarding pesticide use and prioritize eco-friendly practices. Our delivery service is conducted by our in-house team using safe transportation methods. Please note that we do not utilize drones for delivery or advertising to maintain regulatory compliance and minimize liability risks.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/12/2022, a delivery vehicle was involved in a minor accident resulting in damage to floral arrangements worth $1,200. The claim was processed and deemed closed after reimbursement. On 09/15/2021, we experienced a theft of floral supplies from our premises amounting to $300, which was reported to local authorities and resolved.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade I, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing surrounding the premises and an onsite security watchperson during business hours.
